message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk," Li Hua suggested several design elements for Yuriko's studio homepage. Specifically, Li Hua proposed incorporating a user feedback section with a simple form for users to leave comments or suggestions. Additionally, he recommended adding a star rating system to enhance user interaction and engagement. Furthermore, Li Hua suggested including testimonials, as they can help build trust with potential clients. To achieve a cohesive look, Li Hua recommended matching the feedback section's design with the overall aesthetics of the studio, suggesting pastel colors to create a welcoming environment. These design elements were aimed at enhancing user experience and making the website more interactive and informative.
